questions.prompt: A town's population is modeled by P(t) = 12,500(0.97)ᵗ, where t is the number of years after 2020. What do 12,500 and 0.97 represent, and what does 1 - 0.97 represent?
questions.prompt_markup: A town's population is modeled by P(t) = 12,500(0.97)ᵗ, where t is the number of years after 2020. What do 12,500 and 0.97 represent, and what does 1 - 0.97 represent?
questions.correct_answer: 12,500 is the population in 2020; 0.97 is the yearly factor (each year the population is 97% of the year before); 1 - 0.97 = 0.03 means the population decreases by 3% per year.
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent interpretation of all three parts, with units (people, per year).
